snippet.title: Tamara - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Try Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3628050/Tamara/

Tamara is a Dungeon Crawler with elements of Survival Horror in a Cyberpunk-Fantasy Setting focused on combat, exploration and resource management. 

It's a gme about an elf with guns. You fight monsters and explore places where all sorts of things went wrong. How you got here is not important. Who you are is irrelevant. What matters is the gun in your hand and the path forward.

Developer: David Kay
X: https://x.com/DavidKayConrad
